## Description

A ~50 × 14 µm green mixotrophic flagellate with chloroplasts, an eyespot and a contractile vacuole.
It swims towards light and photosynthesises, but can also absorb food. Its pellicle of helical strips
lets it change shape (metaboly). It needs vitamin B₁₂.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `moss` (weight 0.25), `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 20 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

Spindle shape (blunt anterior pole with the reservoir and flagellum, pointed tail). Helical swimming,
[phototaxis and a photophobic response](../../mechanics/behavioural-responses.md) that together leave it in
moderate light. [Metaboly](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md) in episodes during which it does not advance.
[B₁₂ auxotroph](../../mechanics/metabolism-and-nutrients.md). Paramylon storage does not react with Lugol.

## Not implemented yet

- Heterotrophic growth on dissolved organic matter in the dark is not separated from mixotrophy.
- No bleaching (loss of chloroplasts with streptomycin or heat).
- Its µmax source is incomplete.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares metaboly with *Peranema*, the phobic response with *Chlamydomonas* and *Blepharisma*, and B₁₂
auxotrophy with the diatoms.
